description.narrative: SOI 2: Rate of treated municipal wastewater discharged into Lake Sevan basin using scalable naturebased solutions.

comment.narrative: 800 mday by 2024 Sources and means of verification are the measured treatment capacity of pilot plants

In progress For achieving this indicator a feasibility study was launched to identify location technical specifications and further parameters of the planned wastewater treatment plant. title.narrative: SOI 3: Number of new/revised Directives/regulatory framework governing the Lake Sevan water resources and ecosystems.

description.narrative: SOI 3: Number of new/revised Directives/regulatory framework governing the Lake Sevan water resources and ecosystems.

comment.narrative: RA Government Decisions

In progress For achieving this indicator 1. The scoping of the policy legal and institutional framework regulating Lake Sevan ecosystem governance started in August 2021 and will be finalized in November 2021. The study will provide information about the current structure and the revision needs related to the regulatory framework governing Lake Sevan water resources and ecosystem.2. To define a new longterm national vision for Lake Sevan a roadmap and methodology development has started in September 2021 and will be finalized in November 2021. 3. To upgrade the policy legal and institutional framework governing Lake Sevan development of a roadmap and methodology has been initiated and will be finalized in November 2021. 4. For the purposes of collecting comprehensive analytical information to support the formulation of a new longterm vision on Lake Sevan and to respectively update the policy and regulatory framework governing Lake Sevan the technical planning and design of the main studies to be conducted started in September 2021. The results are expected in December 2021. 5. To support the Ministry of Environment in the regulation of the legal relationships related to secondary water use in accordance with the requirements of the Water Code a ToR is under development to conduct the respective analyzes. Based on recommendations and results of the analyzes the abovementioned regulations will be elaborated. Setting up the regulations to incentivize secondary water use will improve the efficiency of water resource uses in the country decrease the environmental pollution including the water use fromat Lake Sevan basin.Sources and means of verification RA Government Decisions
